description: This PHP source file defines the class `CalendarProviderType`, which represents an immutable value object for calendar provider configuration within SuiteCRM. It includes properties such as name, authentication method, enabled status, class, and file, along with getter methods.

classes.name: CalendarProviderType
classes.description: Represents a calendar provider type as an immutable value object, containing identifying and configuration data for a calendar provider.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the calendar provider is enabled.

methods.name: getAuthMethod
methods.description: Retrieves the authentication method used by the provider.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the calendar provider.

methods.name: getClass
methods.description: Retrieves the class associated with the provider.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns the filename related to the provider.
